question_axes.question: Is revenue growth durable or a single product cycle?
Is end demand real and customer-confirmed?
Can customer capital spending support the growth plan?
Are design wins converting into revenue?
Can supply, foundry, and packaging support the plan?
Are margins sustainable as mix shifts?
What competitive responses could invalidate the plan?
Has management historically delivered against guidance and long-term targets?

verification_seeds.title: Verify industry demand, customer capex, competition, and supply
verification_seeds.description: Check customer capital spending, competitive responses, and whether supply can support the plan.

verification_seeds.title: Measure earnings-window price reaction versus indexes and the sector ETF
verification_seeds.description: Compute event-window returns versus SPY, QQQ, and the sector ETF. Describe fundamentals-versus-price tension. Do not conclude that news is priced in.

verification_seeds.title: Seek counter-evidence and alternative explanations
verification_seeds.description: Attack demand, execution, customer concentration, margin, and valuation assumptions. Record opposing evidence and unresolved gaps.

valuation_framework.multiple_reason: semiconductor earnings power is valued on forward EPS times a cycle PE band; current TTM PE is a reference, not automatically the 2-year base multiple
